scope: Independent game-selling economics on itch.io: supply, real paid demand, fees, net earnings, discoverability, distributions, first-game release, and operational risks.

phases.title: Scope the marketplace and measurement rules
phases.exit: Define units, access, charges, and evidence protocols; make no market observations.

phases.title: Measure paid-game supply, competition and discovery
phases.exit: Gather bounded game-catalog, release, traffic and competition evidence or document unavailable datasets.

phases.title: Measure sales, profit, rights and continuity risks
phases.exit: Establish compatible paid-unit, seller-net and zero-earner measures without treating anecdotes as distributions.

phases.title: Design viable earning experiments
phases.exit: Prepare falsifiable and bounded release strategies; do not conduct experiments without authorization.

deliverables: Representative developer-income and zero-earner analysis where obtainable
Evidence-linked earning opportunity and risk synthesis
evidence_rules: The inventory contains questions, not findings.
Research source and claims arrays are currently empty.
Dated public or consented aggregate evidence is required for research progress.
Missing earnings statistics are unknown, not zero.
Research, account access and experiments require separate authorization.
